page.layout: One printed page with a central text column framed by rules; a decorative woodcut band above the title; a narrow margin note at the right beside the text; a catchword line at the foot. Faint show-through from the reverse page is not transcribed. Reading order: title block, section heading, body paragraph, margin note, foot line.

main_text.head: ROMA IRRECONCI- LIABILIS.
SECTIO I. Status Romanæ Ecclesiæ.
main_text.p: NUlla æque homi- num ingenia tor- quet hodie, ac quæ de Ecclesia quæstio est : Infantiam quidem Ecclesiæ sublimior hære-
C.Cass. lib. de Consult. Art. 7. Ex articulo hoc de Ecclesia, om

page.notes: The initial N is a woodcut initial, joined to the first word as "Nulla". The margin note at the right is set in italic type and is transcribed where it stands, as a foot line. The catchword "sis" is the last word of the column, printed at the foot right of the signature B. Faint show-through text from the reverse page (e.g. "Roma Irreconciliabilis", "Deo de Christo") is omitted.
